title: When the Aftermath Wakes
author: Paloma Nakamura
blurb: Mara Ishikawa, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
